verdict.rationale: Unleash's docs cover gradual rollouts to a subset of users, percentage-based activation strategies (e.g. 75% of users), and changing who gets a feature without redeploying. Impact metrics and release templates also support staged progression such as 25% to 50%. However, nothing in the evidence documents consistent or sticky bucketing, so that core part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of consistent/sticky user bucketing (stickiness or hashing), evidence of fine-grained 1% to 100% ramp increments, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying
